canonicalTunables.description: time between shots (cadence); the spine of weapon feel
latency from fire input onset to an explicit projectile-spawn signal
time to kill the reference enemy (first-hit to death)
3D projectile travel speed from a true {x,y,z} trajectory
constant yaw turn rate in degrees/second (no supported angular unit today — left unitless)
look-input onset to the first player yaw response in a 3C controller/camera slice
angular error between aim/camera forward and the fired shot direction (degrees; unitless until angular units exist)
fire input to raycast-hit impact latency for an instantaneous (hitscan) weapon; live-proven in 3D
enemy reaction time from line-of-sight perception to first reaction (aim/fire); live-proven in 3D
peak camera-transform displacement (world units) on hit / kill; live-proven in true 3D
hit-stop freeze WINDOW duration on impact / kill for weight; live-proven in the 3D fixture
per-shot recoil kick in degrees (needs a recoil pulse calculator; no supported angular unit today — left unitless)
player planar move speed (no 3D move-speed calculator yet)

band.qualitative: controllable per-shot kick with a readable recovery
responsive, fair, and readable aim at the named perspective

notes: First 3D-shooter SEED, widened by the productization phases. Honestly measurable TODAY (each binds an implemented calculator, all live-proven or phase-proven in unity-projects/shooter-3d-combat-dogfood when the build exposes the corresponding sampled fields): fireIntervalMs, fireInputToSpawnLatency, ttkMs, true-3D projectileSpeed, constant yaw aimTurnRateDegPerSec, hitscanImpactLatencyMs (fire -> raycast-hit -> damage), enemyReactionLatencyMs (LOS perception -> reaction), true-3D screenShakeMag (peak camera displacement, world units), hitstopMs (hit-stop window duration), and the 3C controller/camera pair lookInputToYawLatencyMs (look-input onset -> first sampled /Player yaw response) + shotAimAlignmentDeg (angle between AimForward and the fired shot direction). The 3C pair was promoted from needs-new-bridge-capability once committed live evidence proved it: demo-bundles/3d-shooter-3c-controller-camera carries the raw runtime.capture_input_motion artifacts (look sweep + aim-then-fire) whose generator re-derives both through the production deriveLookInputToYawLatencyMs / deriveShotAimAlignmentDeg calculators (16.66ms look latency; 0deg shot/aim alignment at 86deg yaw). Still explicit gaps, NOT measurable-now claims: recoil needs a kick-then-recover calculator; ADS needs state/FOV/reticle transition sampling. Hit-stop / screen-shake FEEL QUALITY (curves, shake shape), broader hitscan features (penetration/spread/recoil/ADS/tracer), and broad enemy AI (behavior trees, tactical movement, cover, waves, pathfinding, aim fairness) remain gaps. Angular metrics remain unitless until the supported profile-unit vocabulary grows an angular unit. aiming-feel is judgment-only and pairs with a humanOracleCheck. See genre-packs/3d-shooter/methodology-gaps.md for raw live evidence.
